title: Understanding Angular Momentum
text: Angular momentum $$L$$ is given by the formula $$L=mvr$$, $$where$$ $$\, \text{m$$} $$is$$ $$the$$ $$mass$$, $$v$$ is the velocity, and $$r$$ is the perpendicular distance from the axis of rotation to the line of motion.

title: Identify the Variables
text: In this problem, the mass $$m$$ of the airplane is $$4.0\times10**{4}\,\text{kg}$$, $$the$$ $$velocity$$ $$v$$ is $$250\, \tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}}$$, $$and$$ $$the$$ $$perpendicular$$ $$distance$$ $$r$$ is the altitude of $$10\, \text{km}$$.
